prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop product-screen concept, landscape 1536x1024, page edge to edge without a browser or device frame.
Primary request: a complete professional redesign of the real Odyssey life-tracking app Tasks screen. Art direction titled Spartan Standard: Greek heroic discipline, the rich oxblood dye and ordered pleats of a Spartan mantle, Aegean light, aged bronze details, with the clarity and restraint of a refined modern productivity app. This is a WORKING APP concept with clearly readable controls, not a game menu or a poster.
Layout: 224px stable left sidebar with Odyssey wordmark, then compact consistent navigation rows Check-In, Tasks (selected), Quests, Journal, Insights. Account and Settings at bottom. Main area has a compact page header Tasks and a solid New task button, a low panoramic artwork strip of an ancient Aegean coastal path with cypresses and distant limestone buildings, a row of filter controls, then a readable task list. The artwork occupies at most 18 percent of the screen. Keep all work controls visible.
Content: small line Friday, 13 November. Supporting sentence Your commitments, clearly laid out. Filters All dimensions, Recurring, One-time, search field with visible Search tasks label. Four sample task rows: 10-minute walk / Vitality / Daily; Read for 20 minutes / Psyche / Daily; Practice a presentation / Prowess / Mon, Wed, Fri; Book a health check / Vitality / One-time. Clearly separate Title, Schedule, Status, and Actions; use Active status and visible Edit actions, a secondary overflow button for destructive actions. Subtle activity mini-calendar on the selected walk row. Quiet sidebar sentence Build the life you choose.
Visual grammar: smoked teal-charcoal working surfaces noticeably lighter than near-black, dark oxblood sidebar, warm ivory text, burnished bronze primary action with very dark label. Semantic green only for actual completed states. Six dimensions use restrained identifiable chips with names. Strong horizontal alignment, 8px spacing rhythm, comfortable 48px interactive rows, 16px readable body and 14-15px controls. Modern humanist sans for the working interface, a restrained inscription-inspired serif only for Odyssey and the Tasks heading. Shallow 8px corners and crisp focusable buttons. Soft natural depth, no neon, glows, shimmer, glass or ornate framing. One small woven-edge motif belongs to the art region only. Realistic tactile premium illustration, no generic flat stock art.
Constraints: conventional sidebar, buttons, form controls and list; no invented scores, XP, rankings, gods, medieval castles or armor. Avoid huge empty regions, tiny uppercase labels, excessive gold, battle imagery, decorative Roman numerals. This is sample content, a proposed design not an existing implemented screen.
